datum: Station diagram frame: STA inches aft of the datum, nose 28, mast 100; WL inches above the keel. The generator's `at` sets that frame 5 degrees nose-up on the skids with the keel 0.40 m above ground at the mast. The rotor mast stays vertical at z -0.25.

after.tail: one stabilizer to the right, raised 25 degrees, one strut

published.height: The TM gives 8 ft 4.3 in (2.548 m) and 8 ft 6 in (2.591 m). The commonly published 8 ft 1.5 in (2.48 m) is 7 cm lower than the Army figure and was not used.

groundAttitude: The body sits about 5 degrees nose-up. The TM side view shows 5 to 6 degrees and the TM overall height caps the fin tip, which needs 5. The photo solve alone cannot separate 3 to 5 degrees (RMS 5.5 to 5.8 px).

photoOverlay.camera: 8.67 m to port, 5.36 m ahead, 0.96 m high, focal 1750 px, 34 degree vertical field
photoOverlay.scale: about 170 px/m at the aircraft, so 5.75 px is about 3 cm
photoOverlay.heldOut: The rotor head was not in the solve. It lands on the photograph's hub after the blade plane moved to the TM's 2.548 m.
discrepancies: Keel height is weakly fixed: the solve prefers 0.42 to 0.45 m, the TM drawings 0.38 to 0.40 m. Kept 0.40 m with the annotated heights.
Aft flank silhouette is about 5 cm inside the photograph near STA 150.
Skid bows are about 3 cm high against the photograph.

inspected: Free cameras all round: rear, top, boom root, exhaust, tail, rotor head and skids
Seat view at the runtime camera, dead ahead at 60 degrees vertical field
Photo-matched render against the photograph, side by side and as an edge overlay
containment: 14,950 sampled cockpit vertices, 0 outside the closed shell of skin and glazing.
limitations: Stabilizer beading, rivet lines around the door frames and canopy glazing retainers are not modelled.
The rotor head is simplified: hub, housings, links and swashplate, without strap packs.
The instrument layout follows a civil-modified panel. Its scale follows 3.125 in and 2.25 in dials.
The horizontal stabilizer chord is 16.8 in from the station diagram; the TM plan view draws 20.9 in.
A flat bulkhead closes the cabin behind the aft seats. The engine and transmission are not modelled.
